objective.text: Distinguish a model-returning fill call from the boolean result of update.

difficulty.rationale: Keep a model reference while applying and persisting changes.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A service assigns $record = $record->update(["name" => "new"]) and later calls $record->getKey(). Why does the latter call fail after a successful update?

options.text: update returns a boolean; retain the model separately or call fill(...)->save() without replacing it.
options.rationale: A successful instance update returns true, so assigning that result overwrites the model variable.

options.text: update returns the new primary-key integer rather than the model.
options.rationale: The instance update result reports success; it does not return the key.
options.misconception: The instance update result reports success; it does not return the key.

options.text: update turns the model into an Eloquent collection containing the updated row.
options.rationale: No collection is produced by this instance mutation.
options.misconception: No collection is produced by this instance mutation.

options.text: The model loses its primary key whenever a fillable attribute changes.
options.rationale: Changing name does not remove id; the failure is the overwritten variable type.
options.misconception: Changing name does not remove id; the failure is the overwritten variable type.
